## Purpose

One of three independent GLM-5.3-Flash perf PRs

| shape | Triton chunk path | FlashKDA |

| 8 x 2048 tokens | 183 us | 49 us |
| 4 x 8192 | 555 us | 146 us |
| 1 x 16384 | 1371 us | 787 us |

title: fix(qsa): clamp the compress gather to the rows this forward has
body_opening:
## Motivation

Related to the IMA error described in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/37633.
In the indexer every group spans`compress_ratio` rows, so a padded entry gathers rows `0..ratio-1` of `token_k`.
A forward that carries fewer than `compress_ratio(4)` token rows — the 1..3 token chunk that ends a request under chunked prefill — therefore reads past `token_k`.
The read almost always lands in neighbouring allocated memory and is absorbed silently, it faults only when it happens to cross an unmapped page.


## Modifications
Clamp the gather row index to the rows this forward actually has:

```python
group_locs = group_locs.clamp_max(source_keys.shape[0] - 1)
```

title: [diffusion][jit_kernel] perf: varlen FA fast path for USPAttention masked branch

## Motivation

When `attn_mask` is supplied to `USPAttention.forward` (joint self-attention with text + image streams of differing valid lengths, e.g. Qwen-Image), PyTorch SDPA cannot use FlashAttention with a non-None mask and falls back to the EFFICIENT (`fmha_cutlassF_*_sm80`) kernel. On Blackwell (B200, SM 10.0) this SM80 path is ~7× slower per call than the native FA4 (`flash_fwd_sm100`) path, dominating the denoise loop.

This PR replaces the SDPA-with-mask path with `flash_attn_varlen_func` after packing Q/K/V at valid positions via a fused Triton kernel pair, plus a per-request precompute hook so the cu_seqlens / indices metadata is built once and reused by every block.
